;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Governance of the Gaza Strip|Gazan officials]] say [[Israel]]i soldiers killed a [[State of Palestine|Palestinian]] farmer on his own land in the [[Gaza Strip]]. An Israeli military spokesperson said that he got too close to the border fence. [http://timesofoman.com/article/129319/World/Middle-East/Israeli-soldiers-shot-and-killed-a-Palestinian-near-the-border-between-Israel-and-the-Gaza-Strip-on- (''Oman Times'')]
*[[Turkish military operation in Afrin]]
**According to the [[Syrian Observatory for Human Rights]], at least 36 pro-[[Syria]]n government troops were killed in a [[Turkey|Turkish]] airstrike in [[Afrin District|Afrin]], [[Syria]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-43271148 (BBC)]
**Turkish troops and the [[Turkish-backed Free Syrian Army|Free Syrian Army]] seize control of the strategic town of [[Rajo, Syria]], from [[People's Protection Units|YPG]] forces. [https://www.almasdarnews.com/article/breaking-turkey-led-forces-seize-major-kurdish-stronghold-west-afrin-prepare-storm-another/ (''Al Masdar News'')] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/mar/03/dozens-of-fighters-killed-in-turkish-airstrikes-in-afrin (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.sfchronicle.com/news/world/article/The-Latest-Turkey-tightens-grip-on-Syrian-12725101.php (AP via ''San Francisco Chronicle'')] 

;International relations
*[[Protectionism in the United States]], [[United States–European Union relations]]
**In a message on [[Twitter]], [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] says the [[United States|U.S.]] will apply a tax on cars made in the [[European Union]] if the E.U. "further" increases tariffs. [https://www.cnbc.com/2018/03/03/trump-threatens-to-slap-retaliatory-tax-on-european-cars-as-trade-war-talk-heats-up.html (CNBC)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-43270388 (BBC)]

;Law and crime
*[["Polish death camp" controversy]]
**Hours after the Polish so-called [[Act on the Institute of National Remembrance#Article 55a and Holocaust controversy|Holocaust Law]] about discussing of historical facts takes effect, the [[Polish League Against Defamation]] sues [[Argentina|Argentinian]] newspaper ''[[Página/12]]'', which it accuses of suggesting [[Poland]] was complicit in the [[Holocaust]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-poland/polish-group-sues-argentine-paper-under-new-holocaust-law-idUSKCN1GF0RF (Reuters)]
*[[Murder of Ján Kuciak]]
**On the day of the funeral of slain journalist Ján Kuciak, for lack of evidence, police release seven [[Italy|Italian]] nationals  who are accused of links with the [['Ndrangheta]] [[Organized crime|mafia]] in a posthumously published investigative report by Kuciak. [http://www.dailystar.com.lb/News/World/2018/Mar-04/440157-slain-slovak-journalist-buried-as-police-free-suspects.ashx (''Daily Star'')]
